en: The Shannon Portrait of the Hon. Robert Boyle, by Johann Kerseboom, from the Science History Institute. The Commons file marks the painting public domain and offers its digital reproduction under CC BY 3.0 with attribution to the Science History Institute. This is a painted portrait, not a photograph of Boyle.
